messages:
cs-jen: P1 customer escalation — multiple ACME customers hitting 503s and gateway timeouts since ~10:14Z. Symptoms: upstream inference worker exits (SIGSEGV) immediately after a GPU allocation failure. Happening right after a model hot-swap. cc @oncall-matt @eng-ryan :rotating_light:

oncall-matt: I'm oncall. grabbing pod logs and node info now.

eng-ryan: saw a brief spike in canary yesterday. could be kv-prefetch + large-ctx interaction. can you paste the failing pod logs (kubectl logs)?

cs-jen: pasted truncated stderr from the pod below:
```
2026-03-18T10:14:22Z worker[pid=34]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-18T10:14:22Z worker[pid=34]: Segmentation fault (signal 11)
2026-03-18T10:14:23Z kubelet: container restarted
```

infra-lisa: Which runtime image tag is that? We rolled a quant/kernel change yesterday — `redwood/runtime:opt-2026-03-17`?

oncall-matt: Pod: hosted-infer-abc123 on gke-us-west1-nodepool g4dn-heavy. Image = opt-2026-03-17. I reproduced in staging with stress runner: large context + embed-heavy request triggers OOM then segfault.

eng-ryan: sounds like an unbounded reservation in the kv-prefetch path for that opt build. repro steps?

oncall-matt: repro steps I used:
1) send batch of 16 embedding requests with context size ~120k tokens
2) set header `X-Redwood-KV-Prefetch: true`
3) use model `redwood-alpha-13b-quant`
Observed: GPU allocation climbs until `cudaMalloc` fails, then SIGSEGV in prefetch thread. Repro ~30s.

cs-jen: Customers are asking for ETA and mitigation. Any quick mitigations?

infra-lisa: Short term: 1) disable auto-hot-swap for that opt image 2) add node taint to avoid scheduling large-ctx requests on g4dn pool 3) rollback hosted pool to `opt-2026-03-10` which was stable.

eng-ryan: I'll open an emergency patch to add bounds checking in kv-prefetch. For immediate mitigation, route affected customers to the smaller-context model variant and set `prefetch_parallelism=2` in the route config.

cs-jen: I'll push the route changes for ACME and inform them. Do we have to offer a credit?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-83 assigned to eng-ryan, oncall-matt. PagerDuty alerted.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: reverting hosted pool to `opt-2026-03-10` — started 10:29Z. ETA ~6m.

eng-ryan: Reproduced locally and saved heap maps / traces. Minimal repro command below:
```bash
python stress_repro.py --batch 16 --ctx 120000 --kv-prefetch
```
Heap map shows steady growth in reserved GPU memory until OOM in the prefetch thread.

oncall-matt: Rollback completed at 10:36Z, error rate back to baseline. One customer still sees connection timeouts from earlier broken connections — restarting gateway and warming caches.

cs-jen: ACME updated. They're happy with rollback for now and want RCA and timeline. Please do postmortem.

eng-ryan: Will do. Opening postmortem doc and PR for the fix (RCA: missing bounds check in kv-prefetch path allowed unbounded reservation on large-context hybrid batches). Will include traces, repro steps, and unit/regression tests.

infra-lisa: Also recommending safer defaults: `prefetch_parallelism=1` and disallow hot-swap on opt-* tags until we run large-context stress tests in CI.

cs-jen: Thanks all — updating CS ticket and scheduling an ACME call. Will close thread after PM doc link.
